name: FeatureHub Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-hosted FeatureHub Open Source edition with unlimited users, flags, applications, environments and feature requests according to the project's official repository.
watch_out: Current LICENSE.txt includes Commons Clause on top of Apache-2.0: selling/hosting the software itself as a paid service is restricted; ordinary internal commercial use differs from resale. SaaS is paid after its 30-day trial. Self-hosted infrastructure is not free.
